Package edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.entity

Class Player

java.lang.Object
edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.engine.Actor
edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.entity.Creature
edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.entity.Player
public class Player extends Creature
The adventurer controlled by the user. The player's actions come from commands submitted to the GameSession, never from the scheduler.

Beyond the common creature statistics, the player has a pack, a wielded weapon and worn armor (both of which stay in the pack), a purse of gold, and a hunger clock.
